response.rationale: Seventeen of eighteen cited sources, including several T1 meta-analyses (Liu 2018, Uchihara 2019, Montero Perez 2013), report vocabulary gains from meaningful input (reading, listening, viewing), and the lone negative item (Feng 2020) only found similar gains across modalities, which doesn't contradict the hypothesis; a caveat is that most evidence concerns exposure and frequency rather than directly measured comprehensibility, so the support is somewhat indirect.
